outline: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解數位訊號處理的理論基礎及其應用技巧。課程內容包含：(1)離散傅立葉轉換及快速傅立葉轉換 (2)Z-轉換在信號處理上之應用 (3)相關函數，迴旋積分及其應用 (4)FIR數位濾波器設計 (5)IIR數位濾波器設計 (6)適應性訊號處理介紹 (7)工程應用及實例研討。

week 1 Introduction and Background – Matlab, Sinusoids, Complex Signals.
week 2 Spectrum Representation

week 4 Sampling and Aliasing
week 5 Sampling and Aliasing
week 6 FIR Filtersweek 7 FIR Filters

week 12 Z-Transforms

week 16 Spectrum Analysis and Fast Fourier Transform.
week 17 Spectrum Analysis and Fast Fourier Transform.
